description: This file defines the SupportClient class within the AWS Support namespace, extending AwsClient and including method annotations for various support-related API operations and their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: SupportClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Support API, providing methods for support operations.

methods.name: addAttachmentsToSet
methods.description: Adds attachments to a support attachment set.

methods.name: addAttachmentsToSetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds attachments to a support attachment set.

methods.name: addCommunicationToCase
methods.description: Adds communication to an existing support case.

methods.name: addCommunicationToCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds communication to a support case.

methods.name: createCase
methods.description: Creates a new support case.

methods.name: createCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new support case.

methods.name: describeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves details about a support attachment.

methods.name: describeAttachmentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about a support attachment.

methods.name: describeCases
methods.description: Lists support cases.

methods.name: describeCasesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists support cases.

methods.name: describeCommunications
methods.description: Lists communications for a support case.

methods.name: describeCommunicationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists case communications.

methods.name: describeCreateCaseOptions
methods.description: Provides options for creating support cases.

methods.name: describeCreateCaseOptionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides options for creating support cases.

methods.name: describeServices
methods.description: Describes support services.

methods.name: describeServicesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes support services.

methods.name: describeSeverityLevels
methods.description: Provides severity level information.

methods.name: describeSeverityLevelsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides severity level information.

methods.name: describeSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Lists supported languages for support cases.

methods.name: describeSupportedLanguagesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists supported languages.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckRefreshStatuses
methods.description: Provides refresh statuses for Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckRefreshStatusesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides refresh statuses for Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckResult
methods.description: Provides the result of a Trusted Advisor check.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckResultAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides a Trusted Advisor check result.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckSummaries
methods.description: Summarizes Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckSummariesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously summarizes Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorChecks
methods.description: Details Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorChecksAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously details Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: refreshTrustedAdvisorCheck
methods.description: Refreshes a Trusted Advisor check.

methods.name: refreshTrustedAdvisorCheckAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes a Trusted Advisor check.

methods.name: resolveCase
methods.description: Resolves a support case.

methods.name: resolveCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves a support case.
